name: cross-review
summary: A different provider reviews each pull request than the one that wrote it (Claude reviews Codex's codex/ PRs, Codex reviews Claude's claude/ PRs, chosen per PR from "agents"): findings tagged P1/P2/P3, each validated against the code first, ending its summary as JSON that keel's own step checks against the diff and posts as inline comments in one COMMENT review; read-only, budgeted, never approves or merges.

secrets.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
secrets.why: Claude's credential (`claude setup-token`), as the claude practice's; each reviewed PR spends model tokens up to .keel/keel.json crossReview.budget.minutes. Either this or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; until one is set the run ends green with a notice

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.why: the alternative to CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, billed per token to the API account; set one of the two, not both

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.why: Codex's credential, only when crossReview.agent is "codex" (and "agents" lists codex): each reviewed PR spends tokens billed to the OpenAI API account (no subscription path), up to crossReview.budget.minutes; until it is set a Codex review ends green with a notice
